input_file.description: Path to the CUDF input file. Corresponds to -i.

output_file.description: Path to the output solution file. Corresponds to -o.

verbosity.description: Verbosity level n. Corresponds to -v n.

lpsolver_script.description: Path to the LP solver script (CPLEX format). Corresponds to -lp.

no_reduce.description: Do not reduce initial problem. Corresponds to -noreduce.

only_aggregate.description: Generate only aggregate constraints. Corresponds to -only-agregate-constraints.

only_deaggregate.description: Generate only deaggregate constraints. Corresponds to -only-desagregate-constraints.

all_constraints.description: Generate all kinds of constraints. Corresponds to -all-constraints.

no_solve.description: Do not solve the problem. Corresponds to -nosolve.

criteria.description: List of optimization criteria strings. Corresponds to -lex..., -lexsemiagregate, etc.
